The Si powder (5µm, 99.99%, Naiou Nano Technology Co.) and Ni powder (5µm, 99.99%, Nanhai TOP Metal Building Material Co.) were weighed at a mass ratio of 49:51 (66.7 at.% Si‒Ni alloy), and mixed with mechanical stirring for 3 h to ensure the uniformity of the resulting alloy.
Then, mixed powder was then pressed into a mold under a pressure of 45‒60 MPa to form a sample block with a diameter of 35 mm and a thickness of 10‒15 mm.
The pressed block was placed in a graphite crucible and smelted at1400 ◦C for 40 min in a vacuum melting furnace (10 Pa) to obtain Si‒Ni alloy.

The RMI process was carried out in a vacuum furnace (∼10 Pa). The temperature was increased at a rate of 8◦C/min, the reaction temperature was at 1270◦C, 1310◦C, 1350◦C, and 1390◦C, respectively. The reaction time was 40 min, followed by cooling rate of 12◦C/min.
